capture: One nonblocking stream; disabled initial window; one fixed stream policy setter and exact semantic getter; THREAD_LOCAL capture then ACTIVE query immediately before sole 1x1x1/1x1x1 integer-copy cuLaunchKernel. End capture then immediately instantiate with flag1, without node inspection between. Exactly one kernel node; read its accessPolicyWindow and require exact requested/stream equality.
cleanup: If necessary end failed active capture once; destroy executable then graph; disable owned stream window and read back num_bytes0; free allocation; destroy stream; unload module; restore prior thread binding then release retained primary-context reference. Attempt every applicable cleanup once even after another cleanup error. No graph replay or context/cache reset or limit change.
failure: Unsupported/error/missing symbol/semantic mismatch stops dependent work and returns2/FAIL_OR_UNSUPPORTED after bounded cleanup. Every invoked CUresult/exception is retained; unsupported is never zero. No alternate window/flags/kernel/attempt. Timeout/fatal is terminal preserved evidence, not retry.
guards: 64-bit Windows; exact ctypes sizes/offsets; pinned PTX; one expected device UUID; CC>=8, positive L2 and maximum persisting/window capacity >=128; existing process context limit>=128 and <=maxpersist; exact256-aligned nonzero allocation. No capability fallback.
memory: The 256-byte allocation is deliberately not initialized or transferred. Kernel source=base and destination=base+128 would be in-bounds but are never accessed because the graph is never replayed. No physical persisting lines are populated by this kernel.
